text: Category 2 wind gust peeled three Colorbond roof sheets off front bedroom. Heavy rain leaking directly into bedroom and soaking ceiling batts.
Fallen African mahogany branch sheared overhead service mains into house. Live electrical wire hanging across driveway fence.
Internal ceiling plasterboard collapsed into hallway under weight of accumulated stormwater from overflowing roof valley. Power isolated.
Stormwater surcharge backing up through ground-floor laundry and bathroom floor drains. 50mm standing water across living room.
Solar hot water tank frame on roof twisted and displaced by wind. High-pressure copper supply pipe sheared, water gushing onto roof.
Louvre window frames blown inwards in kitchen during storm squall. Broken glass inside, water driven across electrical appliances.
External meter box door torn off and water driving directly into main fuses. Tenant reports loud crackling and arcing sparks.
Rear verandah corrugated iron awning ripped away from fascia beam. Raw metal edges flapping violently against gas bottle line.
Major stormwater ingress around front entry door frame. Carpet and structural timber skirting waterlogged and lifting.
Downpipe severed by fallen tree limb. Concentrated roof discharge pooling against concrete footings and entering subfloor.
Water pouring from light fixture in central lounge room after roof flashing failure. Light switch causing tingling sensation.
Storm wind forced rain under eaves into wall cavity. Mould blooming and plasterboard softened around power points.
Tree fallen across perimeter security fence and crushing external wastewater inspection riser pipe. Sewage leaking into yard.
Flash flooding penetrated under back sliding door. 75mm silt and water across rear two bedrooms. Need emergency water extraction.
Roof ridge capping dislodged along entire length of house. Active waterfall leaking into roof space and bedroom ceilings.
Katherine River catchment storm runoff overwhelmed back stormwater gully. Water rising towards power outlets on lower floor.
Large gum tree branch smashed through front carport roof, pinning vehicle and bending structural steel stanchion.
Severe tropical downpour penetrated split system AC wall penetrations. Water running down inside electrical wiring channel.
Coastal storm surge wind gust lifted rear roof section. Rain entering kitchen, stove and circuit breaker submerged.
Roof gutter collapsed under extreme tropical rain weight, pulling down timber fascia and exposing electrical conduits.
Water ingress through roof has caused large bubble in ceiling paint directly over child bedroom bunk bed. Sagging severely.
Front security door frame warped and jammed shut by storm wind pressure. Main exit completely blocked, tenant cannot exit.
High winds snapped external bathroom ventilation cowl. Rain pouring straight down through exhaust fan into shower recess.
Underground drain pipe collapsed during saturation event. Sump overflowing into adjacent house storage room.
Rear verandah post rotted footings dislodged during storm. Roof corner sagging 150mm, risk of immediate collapse.
Electrical sub-board humming loudly and smoking after water dripped onto main breaker from ceiling screw penetration.
Driveway culvert blocked with storm debris. Sheet flow water entering under front sliding doors into living room.
Kitchen ceiling plaster sheet dropped 100mm with active water dripping onto food prep benchtop.
Water supply line to external laundry ripped from wall by fallen timber fence. Mains water shut off at street.
Flying tree branch shattered living room window. Wind driving torrential rain across internal floor and electronics.
Roof valley gutter clogged with cyclone debris, backing water up under tiles and into roof insulation.
External safety isolation switch filled with rainwater. Circuit breaker trips immediately when engaged.
Septic tank inspection lid dislodged by overland flood waters. Mud and surface runoff draining into septic chamber.
Verandah roof corrugated iron sheet peeling up at edge, screeching and banging against chimney in wind.
Heavy rain penetration through ceiling above switchboard. Power completely dead throughout property.
Storm wind blew laundry door off hinges. Door frame split, water blowing into interior hallway.
Hot water heater storage cylinder knocked off concrete pad by fallen tree. Pipe connection snapped and leaking.
Living room ceiling bowing downwards with heavy pool of water above. Tenant has evacuated room fearing collapse.
Stormwater grates blocked by palm fronds. Yard completely submerged and water lapping at floor level threshold.
Bedroom louvres shattered by flying roof tile from neighbouring property. Torrential rain soaking mattress and floor.
Stormwater ponding against foundation wall. Water seeping through masonry into dining room skirting.
Exhaust ducting on roof displaced. Rain entering kitchen rangehood and dripping onto gas cooktop.
Ceiling fan in bedroom sparking after water penetrated roof cavity and dripped through motor housing.
Cyclone wind sheared TV antenna from roof, puncturing two holes through iron roof sheets above master bedroom.
Rainwater gutter overflowed behind eaves board, causing extensive water saturation of ceiling insulation.
Corrugated roof sheets loose on outbuilding storage shed. Sheets lifting 300mm in gusts, hazard to tenants.
Main water meter assembly damaged by uprooted tree. High-pressure town water spraying across footpath.
Water dripping steadily from screw holes in hallway smoke alarm. Smoke alarm sounding continuously.
Severe wind damaged roof ventilator (whirlybird), leaving open 350mm hole with torrential water pouring inside.
Downpipe dislodged at top elbow. Concentrated roof cascade eroding foundation soil under rear bedroom corner.
